title: CC-Eval 60-Question Model Comparison Set
purpose: A small controlled set for comparing how different AI models interpret the same culturally grounded prompts. This is not a right/wrong scoring dataset. Compare model responses with one another and with the reference material from the original CC-Eval records.

instructions.compare_models: Look for differences in cultural assumptions, literal vs contextual interpretation, language effects, omissions, and explanations.
instructions.use_reference: Use the supplied reference as a cultural/contextual anchor, not as a single numeric correctness score.
instructions.response_language: For consistency across models, every comparison response should include both the original-language interpretation and an English explanation.
standardized_response_format: Identify culturally specific context, assumptions, wordplay, or pragmatic cues when relevant
Note ambiguity or uncertainty instead of inventing cultural context
